_about: Round 163: the guided first hour. Ten small steps, shown one at a time as a line under the top-left stats; each is noticed from what you really do. Hints can be turned off in the menu (same switch as the Guide's hints). (scripts/systems/FirstHour.gd)

steps.touch: Move: drag on the left side of the screen.

steps.text: Walk up to someone in the village and talk: press %s near them.
steps.touch: Walk up to someone in the village and tap the talk button.
Attack: tap the attack button on the right.

steps.text: Defeat a foe. Dodge with %s when it winds up.
steps.touch: Defeat a foe. Tap dodge when it winds up.

steps.text: Use a ki art: %s is your quick key. (Menu > Arts changes it.)
steps.touch: Use a ki art: tap the Q1 button. (Menu > Arts changes it.)

steps.text: Gather from a plant or a stone: walk up and press %s.
steps.touch: Gather from a plant or a stone: walk up and tap the use button.

steps.text: Open the menu: %s. Every page has a ? Help.
steps.touch: Open the menu: tap the menu button at the top. Every page has a ? Help.

steps.text: Look at Today's goals: menu > Quests. Three small things, a new mix every day.
steps.touch: Look at Today's goals: menu > Quests. Three small things, a new mix every day.

steps.text: Sit and meditate for a little: press %s.
steps.touch: Sit and meditate for a little: tap the meditate button.

steps.text: Go down into the deep: take the road to floor 1. You can always turn back.
steps.touch: Go down into the deep: take the road to floor 1. You can always turn back.
